name: Volume
author: WinDock
description: The default output's volume as an icon, a ring that fills up or a bar, with the level in percent. Wheel: change it, with a volume bar beside the dock; click: a popup with a slider, mute, microphone mute, the outputs and Sound settings; middle click: mute.

settings.label: View
settings.description: How the level is shown. Icon: the icon alone. Ring: a circle that fills up clockwise around the icon. Bars: a bar that fills left to right, or bottom to top, next to the icon. Default: icon.

settings.label: Icon
settings.description: The icon drawn. The speaker's waves and the level bars follow the level; every icon is crossed out while muted. Without an icon the level in percent stands in its place. Default: speaker.

choices.label: An image or a file's icon (below)

settings.label: Image
settings.description: A picture (PNG, JPEG, WebP, BMP, GIF), or any other file, whose Windows icon is drawn (an .ico, .exe, .lnk ...). Faded while muted.

settings.label: Size
settings.description: How big the widget is: 1 is the usual size, 2 twice as big. On a dock a bigger widget wants a thicker bar (Dock settings > Layout > Thickness). Default: 1.

settings.label: Show the level in percent
settings.description: Writes the volume level in percent with the icon, the ring or the bar. On by default.

settings.label: Font
settings.description: The font of the percentage: a font family installed on this PC. Empty: Segoe UI.

settings.label: Show a volume bar while the wheel changes the level
settings.description: Shows a volume bar beside the dock while the wheel changes the level. On by default.

settings.label: Icon colour
settings.description: The icon's colour (not an image's). Transparent (#00000000): the theme's text colour.

settings.label: Percentage colour
settings.description: The colour of the percentage. Transparent (#00000000): the theme's date colour.

settings.label: Level colour
settings.description: The filled part of the ring or the bar. Transparent (#00000000): the theme's accent colour.

settings.label: Wheel step (percent per notch)
settings.description: How much one notch of the mouse wheel changes the volume. Default: 2%.

settings.label: Middle click
settings.description: What a middle click on the widget does: mute or unmute the sound, or nothing. Default: mutes / unmutes.
